planets.name: WASP-67 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of WASP-67 with a 4.61-day year, found in 2012.

text.card: WASP-67 b was found in 2012 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around WASP-67. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname STASSUN_ET_AL__2017): disc_year 2012, disc_facility SuperWASP, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 4.6144166, pl_radj 1.15, pl_bmassj 0.43
